bdellium.e: Borrowed from Latin bdellium, from Ancient Greek βδέλλιον (bdéllion), itself perhaps from Hebrew בְּדֹלַח (bdólakh), cognate with Akkadian 𒁉𒁺𒌨𒄷 (bidurḫu) or from Sanskrit भिदुर (bhidura, “something brittle, fragile, easily split or broken”).

s.d: aromatic gum resin; similar to myrrh
(uncountable) An aromatic gum-like balsam extracted from one of several species of tree in the genus Commiphora.
